title: 2026-11-02 **`time-without-datetime` reads a
notes: length as a time.** On agropex.es a variation button labelled "100 m" (a
100-metre roll) is reported as a time without `datetime`, because
deliberately keeps "12 m" as a duration, so the fix is a decision, not a
typo. agropex-theme excludes the rule in `codeality-ui.json` meanwhile.
Smallest step: decide whether a spaced bare "m" stays a duration; if not,
add `expect(isTimestampText('100 m')).toBe(false)` beside the "12 m" case
and accept bare `m` only unspaced ("5m") or with "ago".
result: RELATIVE_TIME_TEXT accepts a bare m only unspaced (5m) or with ago; a spaced "100 m" is a length, not a duration.
evidence: fields.test.ts: '100 m', '12 m', '100 m roll' now not timestamps, '12m' and '12 m ago' still are; turbo type-check/lint/test/build for @syntopica/ui-quality 5/5 green (544 tests), lint:fast, format:check, dupes pass.
